import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def obj_color(r_):
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(x for x in r_ if x!=r_[0]).most_common(1)[0][0]
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[list(r_) for r_ in g]
    for i,r_ in enumerate(g):
        u=r_[0]
        # last contiguous bg run start
        j=W-1
        while j>=0 and r_[j]==u: j-=1
        if j<0: continue
        k=j  # last non-bg cell index
        oc=obj_color(r_)
        got=False
        for t in range(1,H):
            jr=i+t
            if jr>=H: break
            ok=True
            # counterpart row must match prefix up to k+1 and extend beyond k
            if W<=jr: continue
            if r_[k+1:]>r_[jr[k+1:-]] if False else True: pass
            if all(r_[c]==g[jr][c] for c in range(k+1)): ok=False
            for c in range(k+1):
                if r_[c]!=g[jr][c]: ok=False; break
            if not ok: continue
            if k>=W-len(g[jr]): ok=False; continue
            if not all(r_[c]==g[jr][c] for c in range(len(r_))): ok=False; break
            if ok:
                for c in range(k+1,W):

                got=True; break
        if not got:
            for c in range(k+1,W): out[i][c]=1
    return out

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get); obj=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sep=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==bg]
    bands=[]; cur=[]
    for i in range(H):
        if i in sep:
            if cur: bands.append(cur); cur=[]
        else: cur.append(i)
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    out=[list(r_) for r_ in g]
    def ref_row(bi,o):
        # find counterpart band & offset
        others=[(k,b2,s2) for k,(b2,s2) in enumerate(zip(range(len(bands)),bands,[b[0] for b in bands])) if k!=bi]
        others.sort(key=lambda t:(t[1][-1]-t[2]) if False else abs(t[2]-bands[bi][0]))
        st=bands[bi][0]; L=len(bands[bi]); n=len(others[0][1])
        o2=o-(st-bands[bi][0])
        if o2<0: o2=n-1-L  # clamp
        if o2>=n: o2=0
        k,o2,b2,s2=others[0][0],o2,others[0][1],others[0][2]
        return k,b2,o2,s2
    for bi,rows in enumerate(bands):
        for o,i in enumerate(rows):
            # last run
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]!=bg: j-=1
            if j==W-1: continue          # last run empty -> nothing to fill

            while k>=0 and g[i][k]==bg: k-=1

            cc=g[b2[o2]]
            for jx in T:
                if cc[jx]==obj: out[i][jx]=1
    return out

def solve(g, dbg=False):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    sep=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==bg]
    b=[]; cur=[]
    for i in range(H):
        if i in sep:
            if cur: b.append(cur); cur=[]
        else: cur.append(i)
    if cur: b.append(cur)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # alignment between band rows: align last obj run of band A to ... hmm use global offset but limit counterpart row selection
    for bi,rows in enumerate(bands_of(g)[0]):
        st=rows[0]; n=len(rows)
        others=b2=[[k2,b2,s2] for k2,(b2,s2) in enumerate(zip(range(len(bands_of(g)[0])),bands_of(g)[0])) if k2!=bi]
        others=[others[0]]  # take first other band
        if not others: continue
        s2=others[0][2]
        d=s2-st
        for o,i in enumerate(rows):
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]!=bg: j-=1
            if j==W-1: continue
            T=list(range(j+1,W))
            if not T: continue
            oo=o+d
            cc=g[oo] if 0<=oo<H else None
            if cc is None or any(v!=cc[0] for v in cc): continue
            for jj in T:
                if cc[jj]==obj: out[i][jj]=1
    return out

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # separator: maximal horizontal run of pure-bg rows
    b=[]; cur=[]
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==bg:
            if cur: b.append(cur)
            cur=[]
        else:
            cur.append(i)
    if cur: b.append(cur)
    bands=[sorted(group) for group in b]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for bi,rows in enumerate(bands):
        st=rows[0]; n=len(rows)
        for o,i in enumerate(rows):
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]!=bg: j-=1
            if j==W-1: continue      # no bg tail
            T=list(range(j+1,W))
            if not T: continue
            others=[rows2 for k2,rows2 in enumerate(bands) if k2!=bi]
            cand=[]
            for k2,rows2 in others:
                s2=rows2[0]; N=len(rows2)
                o2=o-(st-s2)
                if o2<0: o2=0
                o2=min(o2,N-1)
                if o2>=N: continue
                cc=g[rows2[o2]]
                cand.append(cc)
            if not cand: continue
            cc=max(cand,key=lambda c:sum(1 for jj in T if c[jj]==min((x for r_ in g for x in r_) if x!=bg and c.count(x)>0 and True)))
            # simpler: pick counterpart whose non-bg content matches ours best
            def score(c):
                nb=sum(1 for jj in T if c[jj]!=bg)
                return nb
            best=max(cand,key=score)
            for jj in T:
                if best[jj]==obj: out[i][jj]=1
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    o=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match' if o==exp else 'MISMATCH')

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(k):
    a=G[k+' input']; e=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in a for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get); obj=min((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    print('===',k,'bg',bg,'obj',obj)
    for i in range(H):
        x,y=a[i],e[i]
        ch=[j for j in range(W) if x[j]!=y[j]]
        if not ch: continue
        # trailing structure of input
        j=W-1
        while j>=0 and x[j]==bg: j-=1
        trun=[jj for jj in range(j+1,W)]
        print(f'row{i} objtruncell{j} trun{trun[:6]}...', '-> ch{ch}')
        # values of counterpart candidates: second band
        sep=[kk for kk in range(H) if len(set(a[kk]))==1 and a[kk][0]==bg]
        print('   separated?',sep)
analyze('Demo pair 1')
analyze('Demo pair 2')
analyze('Demo pair 3')
analyze('Demo pair 4')
analyze('Demo pair 5')

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    objs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obj=objs[0] if len(objs)==1 else min(objs,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    # pattern rows: contain non-bg
    pat={i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=bg for x in r)}
    bands=[]; cur=[]
    for i in sorted(pat):
        if cur and i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        elif cur: bands.append(cur); cur=[]
        cur=[i]
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for bi,brr in enumerate(bands):
        for i in brr:
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]==bg: j-=1
            start=j+1
            T=list(range(start,W))
            if not T: continue
            best=None
            for bk,brr2 in enumerate(bands):
                if bk==bi: continue
                for jj,jjrow in enumerate(brr2):
                    # LCP of g[i] and g[jjrow]
                    lc=0
                    while lc<W and g[i][lc]==g[jjrow][lc]: lc+=1
                    ch=sum(1 for q in T if g[jjrow][q]==obj)
                    key=(ch,-lc,jjrow)
                    if best is None or key>best[0]: best=key
            ch_,jjrow=best[0],best[2]
            for q in T:
                if g[jjrow][q]==obj: out[i][q]=1
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obj=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pat={i for i,r in enumerate(g) if obj in r}
    bands=[]; cur=[]
    for i in sorted(pat):
        if cur and i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        elif cur: bands.append(cur); cur=[]
        cur=[i]
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # precompute for each pattern row p: whether it ends with a period-2 alternating obj/bg suffix
    def alt_suffix(p):
        best=0
        for s in range(W):
            ok=all(((p[q]!=bg)<(q-s)%2==0) for q in range(s,W)) if any((p[q]!=bg) for q in range(s,W)) else False
            if ok: best=W-s
        return best
    alts={p:alt_suffix(p) for p in pat}
    for bi,brr in enumerate(bands):
        for idx,i in enumerate(brr):
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]==bg: j-=1
            T=list(range(j+1,W))
            if not T or not all(g[i][q]==bg for q in T): continue
            tstart=T[0]
            best=None
            for bk,b2 in enumerate(bands):
                if bk==bi: continue
                for p in b2:
                    # source must itself be alternating after its own trail start
                    ps=j2=W-1
                    while ps>=0 and g[p][ps]==bg: ps-=1
                    st=pst=ps+1
                    as_=alts[p]
                    # source alternating phase at target tail start: obj iff (tstart-ps) odd
                    phase = ((tstart-ps)%2)==1
                    ch=sum(1 for q in T if g[p][q]==obj and ((q-tstart)%2)==phase)
                    key=(as_,ch,p)
                    if best is None or key>best: best=key
            _,_,p=best
            for q in T:
                if ((q-tstart)%2)==((W-p[ps])%2==1): out[i][q]=1  # placeholder; redo below
            # set based on phase from winner:
            ps=W-1
            while ps>=0 and g[p][ps]==bg: ps-=1
            st=pst=ps+1
            phase=((tstart-ps)%2)==1
            for q in T:
                if ((q-tstart)%2)==phase: out[i][q]=1
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obj=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pat={i for i,r in enumerate(g) if obj in r}
    bands=[]; cur=[]
    for i in sorted(pat):
        if cur and i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        elif cur: bands.append(cur); cur=[]
        cur=[i]
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # anchor = row of each band with longest trailing run (extends to right edge), or just last row of band
    info={}
    for bi,brr in enumerate(bands):
        anchor=max(brr,key=lambda p:sum(1 for q in range(W) if g[p][q]==obj))
        cols=[q for q in range(W) if g[anchor][q]==obj]
        info[(bi,anchor)]=(min(cols)%2,max(cols))
        # parity: obj columns mod 2
    for bi,brr in enumerate(bands):
        st=min(brr)
        for idx,i in enumerate(brr):
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[i][j]==bg: j-=1
            T=list(range(j+1,W))
            if not T or not all(g[i][q]==bg for q in T): continue
            best=None
            for bk,ap in [(bk,(bk,p,g[bk_p][p])) for bk,b2 in enumerate(bands) for bk_p,p in enumerate(b2)]:
                if bk==bi: continue
                cset=info[(bk,p)]
                ch=sum(1 for q in T if (q%2)==cset[0])
                key=(ch,-bk,-p)
                if best is None or key>best: best=key
            _,bk,p=best
            par=cset=(info[(bk,p)])
            for q in T:
                if q%2==par[0]: out[i][q]=1
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:

    d=[i for i in range(len(o)) if o[i]!=e[i]]

for k in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 8']:
    g=G[k+' input']; e=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)

    b=[]; cur=[]

        cur=[i]
    if cur: b.append(cur)
    print(k,'W',W,'obj',obj,'bands:',[[x[0],x[-1]] for x in b])
    for p in range(H):
        if any(g[p][c]==obj for c in range(W)):
            j=W-1
            while j>=0 and g[p][j]==bg: j-=1
            T=list(range(j+1,W))
            ch=sum(1 for q in T if g[p][q]==obj)
            d=[q for q in T if e[p][q]!=g[p][q]]

def f(gin):
  g=[r[:]...]; H,W=len,g; cnt=Counter; obj=min(cnt,key=cnt.get) if len(cnt)>1 else None; bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
  bands=[]; cur=[]
  for i,r in enumerate(g):
    if all(v==bg for v in r):
      if cur: bands.append(cur); cur=[]
    else: cur.append(i)
  if cur: bands.append(cur)
  pred=[r[:] for r in g]
  for bi,b in enumerate(bands):
    for i in b:
      # trailing solid bg run
      st=W-1
      while st>=0 and g[i][st]==bg: st-=1
      reg=[q for q in range(st+1,W)]
      if not reg: continue
      # candidate src: row in different band maximizing obj count in reg
      best=None
      for bi2,b2 in enumerate(bands):
        if bi2==bi: continue
        for s in b2:
          n=sum(1 for q in reg if g[s][q]==obj)
          if best is None or n>best[0]: best=(n,s)
      if best is None: continue
      _,s=best
      for q in reg:
        if g[s][q]==obj: pred[i][q]=1
        else: pred[i][q]=bg
  return pred

# Hypothesis: each band has one "source" row. Every other band row is a shifted copy of that source
# (with wraparound). For rows whose run gets cut by bg-tail, extend using source's wrapped continuation
# and recolor obj-colored continuation cells to 1.
import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(gin):
    g=[r[:] for r in gin]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    pred=[r[:] for r in g]
    # identify "solid-source" rows: last cell not bg
    srcs={s for s in range(H) if g[s][W-1]!=bg}
    for j in range(H):
        st=W-1
        while st>=0 and g[j][st]==bg: st-=1
        if st==W-1: continue
        # best (s,o) maximizing match count on entire row; tie-break: fewer changed? use max then min o
        best=max(((sum(1 for q in range(W) if g[j][q]==g[s][(q-o)%W]),s,o) for s in srcs for o in range(W)),key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1]))
        mm,s,o=best
        if mm < len(objs*0+ sum(1 for q in range(W) if g[j][q]!=bg)):
            pass
        for q in range(st+1,W):
            if g[s][(q-o)%W]!=bg: pred[j][q]=1
    return pred

for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; eo=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    p=f(gi)
    mism=[j for j in range(len(p)) if p[j]!=eo[j]]
    print('demo',i,'match:',not mism,'mismatches:',mism[:10],'count',len(mism))
